subject: Hosted API architecture workshop — scheduling and agenda confirmation
messages:
From: Elena Brooks <elena@pulsehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: PulseHealth Integrations <integrations@pulsehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: Hosted API architecture deep-dive

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the intro earlier this week. We'd like to schedule a technical deep-dive with the PulseHealth integrations team to review how we would integrate Redwood's hosted API into our ingestion and runtime pipelines. High-level topics we want covered: SDK integration patterns, streaming responses and reconnects, tool/function calling for retrieval + actions, token/security considerations, and recommended quantization/latency tradeoffs for 2–5 QPS with burst to 20.

Proposed duration: 60–75 minutes (tech + Q&A). Preferred window: week of Jul 12 (we're in ET). Suggested attendees: me (integration PM), Dan Ortiz (platform engineer) and our SRE lead (cc'd). Please include whoever from your side owns SDK examples and a runtime architect.

Attaching our integration requirements packet for context (high-level traffic patterns + data classification).

Looking forward —
Elena

Attachments: pulsehealth_integration_requirements.pdf (PDF, 780 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Brooks <elena@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API architecture deep-dive

Elena — thanks for the packet, that's helpful. Monica (solutions engineering) and Laura (partner architect) are looped in — both will join the session. A few quick clarifying questions before we lock time so we can tailor the demo:

- Are you planning to use the Redwood hosted API or a Dedicated pool for this integration initially? (we can show both patterns)
- Expected payloads: will you be sending full patient notes (PHI) or metadata+IDs with retrieval? That affects recommended encryption/KMS setup.
- Primary SLO target: 200–500 ms median token latency, or are you optimizing for throughput?

Proposed times (ET):
- Tue Jul 13, 15:00–16:15 ET
- Wed Jul 14, 11:00–12:15 ET

We'll prepare: short architecture sketch, SDK streaming demo (node + python), a short live tool-calling example that triggers a retrieval lambda, and a slide with recommended quantization/latency profiles. I'm attaching an internal questions doc so Monica/Laura can validate before the call.

If Tue 7/13 15:00 ET works, I can send a calendar invite and a short pre-read.

Cheers,
Marcus

Attachments: internal-pulsehealth-questions.docx (DOCX, 34 KB)

From: Elena Brooks <elena@pulsehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: PulseHealth Integrations <integrations@pulsehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 14:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API architecture deep-dive

Marcus —

Tue Jul 13 at 15:00 ET works for us. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-pulsehealth-architect-workshop (please accept).

A couple notes for prep:
- We'll have Dan Ortiz (platform) and Rita Gomez (SRE) on the call. They will ask about service account scoping and retention windows.
- We're currently planning to send de-identified notes + retrieval IDs, but we may pilot wrapped PHI in an isolated Dedicated environment if needed.

I've uploaded a short Confluence page with our integration constraints and a shared drive folder for sample logs: https://confluence.pulsehealth.com/display/INT/Redwood+Integration+Prep

Attaching our data classification brief as well.

Thanks — see you Tue,
Elena

Attachments: data-classification.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Hosted API architecture workshop — scheduling and agenda confirmation

Team — final confirmation for tomorrow's call (Tue Jul 13, 15:00 ET). Elena confirmed attendees and shared the Confluence prep. Action items for us: 

- Monica: come prepared with the SDK streaming demo (Node + Python) and 90-second summary of reconnect/backpressure behavior. Attach code snippet in the drive: redwood-sdk-streaming-example.zip.
- Laura: prepare the architecture diagram showing hosted vs dedicated routing, fallback policies, and suggested network/KMS notes (we should highlight how to pin model versions for canary).
- Marcus: I'll own the tool-calling demo (short retrieval -> action flow) and the recommendations slide on quantization vs latency for their expected QPS.

Agenda (60–75m):
1) 5m intros
2) 15m Redwood architecture + routing patterns
3) 20m SDK streaming demo + reconnect behavior
4) 10m tool-calling + example retrieval flow
5) 10–25m Q&A and next steps (procurement/contact for Dedicated pool)

I'll upload the agenda & slides to the shared drive and send updated invite with zoom link. Please review the internal questions doc and add notes by EOD today.

Thanks,
Marcus
